Sandbox_TheIntruder_ForcePvp_tooltip: When an intruder arrives, turn off safety for everyone so they can fight. Requires the server PVP option.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_MaxIntruders_tooltip: How many intruders can be present on the server at the same time.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_SpawnDistance_toolti: How close to a normal player an intruder spawns.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_RespawnCooldown_tool: Delay before a dead intruder can invade again. 0 means no delay.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_KitMelee_tooltip: Melee weapon given to the intruder on spawn.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_KitBag_tooltip: Bag given to the intruder on spawn.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_KitFood_tooltip: How many canned food items the intruder starts with.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_KitFirstAid_tooltip: Give the intruder some bandages on spawn.
Sandbox_TheIntruder_KitCustomItems_toolt: Extra item ids separated by a semicolon, for example Base.Pistol;Base.Bullets9mm
